findings.text: The diff has only the `Server/merge.mjs` warning. The requirements.md deliverables are missing: no `report.md` (the two numbers, the ten-task table, the cause), and no move of up to 5 buried decisions into module readmes. The task folder holds only requirements, past-work, inbox and session.jsonl, so a fresh agent can't tell what the audit found.

`Server/merge.mjs` is Server code, but the diff changes no `Server/readme.md` or `Server/doc/*.md`. The new "Docs:" warning isn't indexed (Server/readme.md:41 lists the merge.mjs behaviours and nav-check.md documents its gate), so it would trip its own warning. Add a line there and a note on `--quick`/override behaviour.

The task has no landing outcome or `decide`/`plan`/`report` file. Requirement 3 (which rule was meant to make this happen, and whether anything checks it) is unanswered, so the reasoning behind the warning is not recorded.

`docsReminder` is inserted straight after the review-gate doc comment (merge.mjs:~170-190), so that comment still sits above the wrong function. `shotsReminder` already did this, but it is worth putting the new function elsewhere.

`mod()` (merge.mjs:~20) only recognises `core|ext|ux|ui|audio|code` under `public/framework/`, plus Servex and Server. A change in another module directory is never warned about. Compare it with the existing `moduleDirOf` and reuse that helper (law 6).

Docs-only landings of `.md` files and test files are exempt, which is sensible. A code change with a trivial doc touch passes, so this checks that docs were touched, not that a decision landed. Say so in the Server doc.
